notes.title: Patch Release: Parity 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hi Parity Players!


While couch-coop hasn't been an option for many of you lately, playing online with your friends is better than ever. We continuously updated the Parity netcode over the last couple of patches, yet we still had major issues dealing with packet loss and bad network conditions.

However, we're happy to announce that we spent our bonus time at home wisely and started a spring-cleaning our Parity codebase. In the process, we fixed many minor glitches and started to analyze our network issues in depth.

We gained some valuable insights and improved the netcode based on our findings.
The result looks quite promising to us! Aside from a minor hiccup then and now, we were able to enjoy some smooth and action-packed online Parity matches in the last couple of days.

We hope you all thoroughly enjoy the new patch, let's play some Parity!


Svonn & Parity Team

notes.title: Patch Release: Parity 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Today we are releasing a new Parity patch that addresses tons of balancing, bot and multiplayer issues.

General

 Tons of multiplayer fixes
 Restores lobby after finishing a game
 Player now look at the ball when the game starts
 You can now leave the lobby if there are only bots left
 The kickoff direction in multiplayer is now displayed for clients
 Reworked some menu navigation and added missing input hints
 Adjusted some SFX volumes
 Fixes freezes and crashes caused by bots
 Fixes magnet glitches that could cause the ball to leave the arena
 Fixes crashes caused by very long chat messages
 Bot difficulty settings now gets saved for future games


Balancing

 Major game speed overhaul: Everything moves at higher speeds but also slows down faster, making the gameplay sharper and action-heavy
 Adjusts tons of minor values for tackling cooldowns, cooldowns for picking up the ball after being tackled, skates adjustments and many more
 Reworks spin shot: Left/Right spin shot now actually shoot to the left or right, enabling the player to "shoot around corners"
 Reworks points for most actions
 Adds new button (Y/LeftAlt) that allows you to request the ball from teammates - including a visual indicator that suggests a pass-direction


Bots

 When requesting a pass, bots will always attempt to pass to the requesting player
 Bots now properly use new spin shots
 Bot passing vastly improved
 Nerfes all difficulties by applying a more realistic brain-lag (decreasing with higher difficulties)
 Improves spacing of bots in highly populated games
 Plenty of other minor improvements


Aside from potential hotfixes for this patch, we're working on a major update for 1.1.
We'll introduce a replay feature and switch to the unity render pipeline, so stay tuned!

Svonn & Parity Team

notes.title: Hotfix: Parity 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas Parity Players,

To ensure the best experience over the holidays we just pushed a new hotfix dealing with some issues some players encountered during online sessions and when testing their skills versus the bot opponents. Other than that, we made some minor gameplay changes to further enhance the competitive aspect of Parity.

General

 Fixes glitch that caused players to be stuck after the host left the game
 Only open pause menu when entering steam overlay during local gameplay and not when the player is in the main menu
 Resolves tons of alignment and display issues for screen aspects other than 16:9 - 16:10 and even 4:3 should be working fine now


Balancing

 Reduces repel-time of spin-shot
 Tackle and Boost disregard current player speed make it more consistent
 Slightly decreases magnet ramp-up time to allow better fake-outs
 Slightly increased player mass when on ice-skates, thus slightly decreasing acceleration and deceleration


Bots

 Removes accidentally applied difficulty modifiers on the level 10 bots, vastly increasing their skill
 Improves goalkeeper movement on non-trivial maps
 Fixes some pathfinding hiccups, improving performance in the process
 Improves offense, defense, and predictive behavior
 Vastly improves 1on1 skills


We're currently working on a hotfix to remove the last few known bugs from online-multiplayer. For instance, the magnet glitch that prevents players from picking up the ball. After that, we'll start working on an actual patch containing new features and quality of life improvements. Stay tuned!

Svonn & Parity Team

notes.title: Hotfix: Parity 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi Parity-Players,

We hope you're having some fun!
Thanks for providing us with some feedback and bug reports, we made sure to address as many as possible in our first hotfix.

Here's a condensed and non-exhaustive list of changes we made:

Online-Multiplayer

 You can finally taunt your enemies
 Clients now see icon change hints
 Fixes spin-shot sometimes not letting anyone close
 Resolves tons of issues regarding joining and leaving games
 Prevents some syncing issues with player skills
 Private lobby codes are now working properly


General

 Sends some freezes and crashed to the code trash bin
 Fixes some pause menu glitches
 Updates bot path-finding 
 Fixes bots sometimes passing towards their own goal
 Now allows spinning your player during game start
 Adds new sounds, adjusts some volumes
 Menu polishing
 Input hints for all scenes
 Player icons now properly align with pickup trigger in front of the player


Thanks for playing our game! Stay tuned for more fixes in the coming days.

Svonn & Parity Team
